Parking lights do not work under any circumstances.
The parking light activation signal (side and number plate lights) is sent directly from the Body Computer Node.
The parking lights are switched on by the driver using the ignition key and the steering column switch unit. With the key in PARK and the lights switched off, there are two cases:
1. Steering column switch unit in neutral lights up all the side lights, no. plate lights and side lights warning light in the instrument panel
2. Steering column switch unit turned to the left or the right, the left or right side lights, respectively, come on
